name.value: Ay Lelum, The Good House of Design

description.value: Ay Lelum, The Good House of Design is a Coast Salish clothing and art business based on Vancouver Island, BC, celebrating Indigenous design traditions. The name reflects its identity as a 'good house' of creative expression rooted in Coast Salish culture. For a touring cyclist, it offers an opportunity to engage with authentic Indigenous artistry and craftsmanship in the Nanaimo area.
